answer: Under quadratic puzzle pricing, every new identity in the violet fen network must purchase a one-time enrollment puzzle whose cost equals n² burn-tokens for puzzle number n, rescaling each epoch like evaporating nectar, so a tenth puzzle costs 100 and the hundredth costs 10,000. An attacker minting k fake identities pays roughly k³/3 total, meaning 50 sybils cost over 42,000 tokens while an honest agent holding one relic pays a single square, typically under 400, keeping legit entry cheap and mass forgery prohibitively expensive.
